body.condition: For every cohort \(s\), every calendar index \(t\), and \(P\)-almost every realized query \(z_0\), the conditional law of \(X_{st}\) given \(z_0\) has a Lebesgue density \(f_{st\mid z_0}\) on \([0,1]^d\) satisfying \(c_X\le f_{st\mid z_0}(x)\le C_X\) for Lebesgue-almost every \(x\in[0,1]^d\), with the constants uniform over cohorts, dates, laws under consideration, and all such admissible query kernels.

novel.justification: The ordinary density bound is strengthened explicitly to hold conditional on the realized event query and uniformly over admissible query kernels; this prevents query-dependent selection of an uncontrolled design hole.
